title: Aoyagi Toya — To The Costuming Team!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Kamiyama High School - Class 2-B

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line: Alright, our class will be doing an interpretive dance!

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line: So, let's start forming teams to come up with the costumes and choreography!

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line: Please come to the front if you're interested in doing either!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Choreography...?
I have a little bit of experience doing that...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, Toya!
Wanna try designing the costumes together?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The costumes...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! I've got a feeling it'll be really fun if we work on them together! What do you say?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, actually...
I was just debating going up.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, really?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I was wondering if I should take this opportunity to try something new...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: At the same time, would it be okay for a novice like me to join...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hmm, it should be fine.
I don't think we'll be making anything too elaborate...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
And don't worry!
I can teach you whatever if you need help!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you...
Then, I think I'll go join.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Awesome!
I'm really looking forward to tomorrow now!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Me too.
Again, thank you.
A few days later

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Be careful when you pass the needle through the back. Watch where your fingers are...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, Toya, you're really getting the hang of this! The fabric's right where it needs to be! Nice work!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm doing a good job...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! It looks like you've mastered what I taught you!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The only other thing you might wanna keep an eye on is your thread knots! Every once in a while, you make one that's floating away from the fabric a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The trick is to hold the needle as close to the seam as you possibly can when you're wrapping the thread around it!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Use your nail to press against the wrapped thread and slowly pull the needle out! By doing that, you'll make sure the thread stays taut.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see...
Thank you, Akiyama. I'll try doing that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Also, you're already done making your costumes? That's incredible. I'm only about a third done with mine...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Heehee! This is my hobby after all.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I won't be able to work as quickly as you, but it would be nice to learn how to make these a little faster.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Don't worry about any of that!
Slow and steady wins the race, right? None of us wanna see you getting hurt, and it'll make the costumes better too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Honestly, you're doing a great job. Your stitching's gorgeous and so evenly spaced, don't you think?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That's really important when it comes to sewing!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Is it...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! The end product looks so much better that way. You get my seal of approval, so you should be proud!

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line: Wait, Aoyagi, you made this?!

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line:
The stitching's immaculate!
How did you do this?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: How...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I don't know... But I was told to keep the spacing even, so I was very careful to do so.

rows.Speaker: Male Students
rows.Line:
And you were able to make this?!
Just how careful were you being...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But that's really important!
It's easy to start cutting corners once you've got the hang of things.

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line:
Then, you should take a look at this.
I was doing slip stitches and... I mean, how bad is this?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. You can see the thread plain as day!

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line:
I know.
Aoyagi, can you teach me how to do this?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Wait, I only just learned this myself...
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line:
Alright, let's stop here!
Nice work today, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Phew...
Akiyama, everyone, thank you for being such good teachers.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I really wasn't sure how I'd do at first... But it was quite fun once I got going.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Really? That's great to hear!
I'm so glad you're saying that!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You're such a quick study, Toya! I think you have a talent for this! I mean, you were doing everything all by yourself without any help towards the end.

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line: Yeah, you're so diligent and committed! I'm so glad you decided to help with the costumes, Aoyagi!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Everyone...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I was worried that I was going to be a burden to everyone because I wasn't familiar with sewing techniques...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But I'm glad that I've been able to make real contributions.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you all very much...
I see that sewing is fun now because of all of you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. You're welcome!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But it's too soon to be patting yourself on the back! We've still got a ton of work left to do...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Things are only gonna get harder, so we gotta stay focused! So, next time, let's try using some sewing machines!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Sewing machines...?
Okay, I'll make sure that I'm ready.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Good! Let's make the most spectacular costumes we can!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes!
